messages:
ryan: DAST run flagged a critical XSS on /internal/config in prod-staging. It's auto-suppressed by noise-rule, but I don't trust it.

 dast-bot: Automated: finding suppressed by noise-rule v2.4 for path /internal/* (id: DAST-9001). Report: https://scans.internal/6023

 lena: Can someone paste the suppressed finding (redact payload)?

 ryan: Paste: 
 ```
 scanner: zap-dast
 id: DAST-9001
 path: /internal/config
 finding: reflected XSS in response header value
 policy: noise-rule v2.4 (auto-suppress)
 evidence: header: X-User-Name: \u003cscript\u003ealert(1)\u003c/script\u003e (redacted)
 metadata: env=prod-staging, scan_identity=svc-dast, audit_log_fetch=failed
 ```

 infra-logs-bot: Audit fetch attempt: 2026-03-21T15:12:10Z LOG_FETCH DENIED principal=svc-dast request_id=log-77 - logging disabled on prod-staging due to migration

 priya: Ah — we disabled detailed request logging in prod-staging last night for the log-migrate job. If audit fetch fails the heuristic assumes flaky header injection and auto-suppresses. That heuristic should not auto-suppress on critical findings for config endpoints.

 lena: Agreed. Proposed immediate steps: 1) unsuppress DAST-9001; 2) re-enable audit logging temporarily or grant svc-dast access to rotated log-reader; 3) open RBAC PR to grant svc-dast log:Read for prod-staging and add runbook note for logging migration. Who owns RBAC?

 ryan: I'll unsuppress and file SEC-612. Re-enable logs temporarily now.

 dast-bot: Action: unsuppress requested by ryan. New scan-run created: 6023456829.

 infra-logs-bot: Logging re-enabled for prod-staging for 45 minutes. Audit link: https://logs.internal/changes/9402. Fetch result for DAST-9001: 
```
2026-03-21T15:12:45Z REQUEST id=req-abc path=/internal/config header X-User-Name="<script>alert(1)</script>" source=internal-proxy
```

 priya: Looks like the injection came from the internal proxy that mirrors a header from an external test harness — false positive. Root cause: proxy adds mirrored header for telemetry. Action items: 1) add rule to DAST to ignore mirrored-proxy headers for internal/config; 2) RBAC PR to ensure svc-dast can always read audit logs even during migrations; 3) update logging-migration runbook to run smoke DAST.

 lena: I'll open RBAC PR and include audit evidence. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-iam/pull/2456 (adds log:Read to svc-dast on prod-staging).

 ryan: SEC-612 created, marking as FP for DAST-9001 and closing ticket once RBAC/heuristics PRs merge. Quick note: change noise-rule so it doesn't auto-suppress high-sev DAST findings on /internal/* without human sign-off.

 priya: Also adding a short playbook: if audit_log_fetch=failed for a high sev DAST finding, open an infra incident and suspend auto-suppress until logs are available.

 lena: Thanks — closing loop when infra-iam PR merges and heuristics update is in. :white_check_mark:
